target: the declared machine is queued -> specd -> building -> built -> reviewing -> pr-open -> done; advance validated only that the target was a valid STATUS, so a spec could skip every stage and every gate attached to them
cmd: bash "$FIXTURES/tracker-gates/mkspec.sh" specs 920 queued; FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance specs/920-t.md done >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "status=$(grep '^status:' specs/920-t.md | head -1)"
